findings.text: requirements.md lists the proof as headless-only on the worktree and gives no screenshot or file name for the "Hello world" div; a fresh agent cannot re-check it. Save a shot (or the headless output) into this task folder and name it in requirements.md.

The new rule is indexed only in core/Item/readme.md:150. core/Page/readme.md and public/live/readme.md (both changed behavior: PageContent and LivePage now call Item.foreign) do not mention it, and /framework/core/View/ does not say it can be built from a page line; add one line each, or one link.

Item.foreign(item) is called in three render paths (PageContent.js:78 and :120, LivePage.js:414 and :442), each building a fresh View on every render; check that re-render or remove does not leave the old div behind, and add a test that draws a page (the Item.test.mjs checks cover hydrate only, not drawing).

PageContent.js:78 sets `result = undefined` before the foreign check, so the previous-result/last-item logic now treats a foreign item as "no result"; this looks intentional but is worth a second look if a View is the last list item.

Item.js now imports View (Item.js:5), so every node-side Item user loads the View module; the test passes, but Item is a core model, and a lazy register from the page code would keep it from depending on the view layer.
